name: io.github.AwakeWeb3/petclaimcheck
title: PetClaimCheck
description: Sourced pet insurance denial rules, appeal steps and escalation paths for the US and Australia.

tools.name: list_insurers
tools.description: List the pet insurers PetClaimCheck covers in a market, with each one's underwriter (sourced), insurer guide URL and free-check URL.

market.description: us for the United States, au for Australia

tools.name: get_insurer_rules
tools.description: How one pet insurer defines a pre-existing condition, treats cured or temporary conditions, bilateral conditions and waiting periods, and its review and escalation path. Every fact has its source URL and the date it was read.

market.description: us for the United States, au for Australia

insurer.description: Insurer id or brand name, e.g. trupanion, lemonade, bupa, medibank

tools.name: get_escalation_path
tools.description: The steps to dispute a denied or declined pet insurance claim in a market (state department of insurance in the US; IDR then AFCA in Australia), with sourced time limits.

market.description: us for the United States, au for Australia

tools.name: get_glossary
tools.description: Plain-English definitions of pet insurance denial terms (pre-existing, chronic, curable, bilateral, waiting period...), each with its source.

market.description: us for the United States, au for Australia

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: What PetClaimCheck does, what it costs, its guarantee and its limits, and the URL where an owner can start a free check themselves.

market.description: us for the United States, au for Australia

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: The questions owners ask before buying, answered as on the FAQ page: what the free check shows, what's in the packet, what if nothing is worth appealing, will my vet sign, do I need a lawyer, why not just use ChatGPT, privacy and more.

market.description: us for the United States, au for Australia

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One plain-English guide or news explainer (for example what counts as a pre-existing condition, cured or curable conditions, bilateral (other-side) denials, waiting periods, how to appeal or dispute, how to complain to a US state insurance department, can ChatGPT write my appeal), with every sourced fact. Call without slug to list the available guides.

market.description: us for the United States, au for Australia

slug.description: The guide's slug, from the list this tool returns without one
